territorial_scope.description: Applies as a statute of the State of Tennessee amending the Tennessee Code Annotated.

evidence.quote: BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF THE STATE OF TENNESSEE

summary.short: Amends Tennessee Code Annotated Section 39-17-1002 on the sexual exploitation of children so that covered images include computer-generated images, including images created, adapted or modified by artificial intelligence, and adds definitions of 'artificial intelligence' and 'generative artificial intelligence'. Takes effect July 1, 2024.
summary.long: Amends Tennessee Code Annotated Section 39-17-1002 (Title 39), which concerns the sexual exploitation of children. Section 1 replaces subdivision (2)(E) so that covered images include any computer image or computer-generated image, expressly including an image created, adapted or modified by artificial intelligence, whatever the means of making or producing it. Section 2 adds two definitions to the same section. 'Artificial intelligence' means a machine-based system that, for human-defined objectives, makes predictions, recommendations or decisions, influences real and virtual environments, or learns and improves from data sets, or that solves tasks requiring human-like perception, cognition, planning, learning, communication or physical action; it includes generative artificial intelligence. 'Generative artificial intelligence' means an AI system capable of creating new content or data, including text, images, audio or video, when prompted by an individual. Section 3 sets the effective date as July 1, 2024. The document states no penalty amounts, enforcement authority, private right of action or exceptions. It adds to existing offense provisions and does not set separate AI-specific duties on developers or deployers.

relations.note: Section 1 deletes and replaces subdivision (2)(E); Section 2 adds new subdivisions defining 'Artificial intelligence' and 'Generative artificial intelligence'. No other instrument is amended in the operative sections.

evidence.quote: SECTION 2. Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1002, is amended by adding the following new subdivisions:

notes: Bill text as provided. The title refers to Title 39 and Title 40, but the operative sections amend only Tenn. Code Ann. § 39-17-1002 (Title 39); no Title 40 provision is amended. The new subdivisions in Section 2 carry blank numbering '( )'. Section 1 extends the existing definition of computer image to images created, adapted or modified by artificial intelligence. Section 3 sets the effective date as July 1, 2024. The text does not state its enactment or signing date. No cross-references to other instruments are stated.

entities.note: The act names no firms, facilities or public bodies. It amends a criminal statute and defines terms.

thresholds.note: The text sets no numeric cutoff that changes legal treatment. The only number is the effective date (July 1, 2024), which is coded as an event, not a threshold.

obligations.note: The act amends definitions in Tenn. Code Ann. § 39-17-1002 (Sections 1-2) and sets an effective date (Section 3). It states no addressee duties of its own. The offence provisions that use the amended definitions are not reproduced in this text, so no obligations are coded.

enforcement.note: The text amends the definition of computer images in TCA 39-17-1002(2)(E) and adds definitions of artificial intelligence and generative AI. It states no penalty, fine, revocation or other sanction. Any penalties for the offences in TCA 39-17-1002 are outside this text.
